APRS101 p. 18 (X1J) allowed a '!' position in the first 40 bytes of other text; the APRS 1.1 addendum deprecates that search, so by default this is a beacon.
With legacy_positions the APRS101 p. 18 search finds the '!' position after the prefix 'X' (a LegacyPosition).
With legacy_positions the search covers only the first 40 bytes (APRS101 p. 18); a '!' after 40 bytes leaves a beacon.
